text: Travel experiences can change our lives. When planning a trip, we often feel excited and a little nervous. Visiting new cultures opens our minds and teaches us how other people live. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, because every dish tells a story about the place. Sometimes we face language barriers, which can be difficult, but they often lead to funny moments and new friendships. In the end, we return home with wonderful memories that stay with us forever.
